# Weekly Client Reporting
1. Pull the week's spend, results, CPA/ROAS and week-over-week deltas per client.
2. Compare to the plan; call out wins, misses, and the one thing changing next week.
3. Generate the report doc from the template + a 4-sentence email summary.
4. Draft for AM review (propose); never send to the client without approval.
